sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/PANARI/PANARI - PRIME TIME TRAVEL LTD 2026 CONTRACT RATES.pdf
notes: Document is a Tour Operator Rate Agreement between Panari Hotels and Prime Time Travel Ltd (not Sunworld directly), but the rate structure/terms are the general template Panari issues to tour operators.

ANOMALY: Agreement term clause states 'shall commence...and shall continue until 31 December 2025' despite this being explicitly labelled a '2026 CONTRACT RATES' document with rates valid into 2027 elsewhere - likely a template carryover error, not corrected here.
STO discount off Rack roughly ~40-45% depending on room/occupancy (e.g. Superior single: 143/250=0.572, i.e. ~43% off).
validity: 3 January - 15 June 2026 and 1 September 2026 - 3 January 2027 (NETT rates)
jkiaTransfer: US$15 per person one way, max 4 pax

refresherPackage.raw: One meal (breakfast/lunch/dinner) + freshening up. US$66pp. Complimentary one-way airport transfer. 3 hours in room.

sundownerPackage.raw: 3 selected cocktails/beers/juices pp + finger foods. US$83pp. Complimentary one-way airport transfer. 3 hours in room.

dayUseRoomOnly.raw: Superior room, single or double. US$105pp. Complimentary one-way airport transfer. 5 hours in room.

dayUseRoomWithMeal.raw: Superior room + one meal. US$132 single / US$160 double. Complimentary one-way airport transfer. 5 hours in room.

circuitDiscount.raw: Groups staying at both Panari Hotel Nairobi and Panari Resort Nyahururu enjoy a further 5% circuit discount - must be stated in booking voucher.

childPolicy.raw: Baby cots free for infants up to 4 years. 5-11yrs sharing with adult: 50% of adult per-person-sharing rate. 5-11yrs in own room: 75% of applicable room rate.

generalTerms.taxesIncluded: STO rates include VAT 14%, Service Charge 10%, Training Levy 2%
generalTerms.applicability: STO rates apply to leisure FIT and group reservations only, not corporate/MICE segments
generalTerms.dayUseGeneral: 50% of STO rate for in-house guests, 75% for new arrivals, applicable up to 18:00 (full rate thereafter)
generalTerms.groupComplimentary: Group of 15+ paying persons/night: 16th person accommodated free (twin or double), max 3 persons/rooms - must be stated in booking voucher
generalTerms.famTripRate: 75% of applicable STO rate, subject to availability
generalTerms.payment: With credit facility: 30 days from invoice. Without: full payment prior to guest check-in.
generalTerms.cancellation: 30-14 days: 50% of room charges for entire stay; 13-3 days: 75%; within 48 hours or no-show: 100%
